name: cg-claude
description: 本地 Claude 环境检测、配置修复与备份恢复工具

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.format: prettier --write src shared server electron tests scripts docs *.json *.ts *.md index.html .github/workflows/*.yml electron-builder.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src shared server electron tests scripts docs *.json *.ts *.md index.html .github/workflows/*.yml electron-builder.yml
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron .
scripts.desktop:demo: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && node scripts/demo.mjs --desktop
scripts.pack: npm run icons && npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run icons && npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --publish never

author: CG Claude
